english_text: A glorious victory will soon be ours!
Alexander failed to account for Spartan's strength, and now he's dead.
czech_text: Alexandr podcenil sílu Sparťanů. Teď je mrtev.

english_text: Allies are among our targets! Cease!
Arminius is dead, and his men fear us!
czech_text: Arminius je mrtev a jeho muži se nás bojí!

english_text: By the gods! Xanthippus is dead!
Caesar has been slain by our forces!
Capture the enemy base, or kill all enemy forces!
czech_text: Obsaďte jejich základnu, nebo zničte všechny nepřátele!

english_text: Cease, you fools! We are allies!
Cunning and strength are of equal import in a battle!
czech_text: V bitvě záleží na důvtipu stejně jako na síle!

english_text: Cynane is felled by our blades!
Defeat will only make us stronger!
DO NOT STOP! PUSH THEM BACK!
Drops are in our perimeter! Step with care!
czech_text: V našem prostoru jsou ježci! Dávejte pozor!

english_text: Go tell the Spartans friend, that here, by their law, we lie.
czech_text: Řekni Sparťanům, příteli: zde ležíme podle jejich zákonů.

english_text: Gods, hear me - bring us victory!
czech_text: Bohové, vyslyšte mě a dejte nám vítězství!

english_text: Hades can wait a little longer!
Hannibal is dead! It is done!
czech_text: Hannibal je mrtev! Je po všem!

english_text: If you cannot aim enough not to hit our own allies, perhaps you should reconsider your profession.
czech_text: Jestli nedokážete mířit mimo spojence, zvolte si jinou službu!

english_text: Mind your step, Spartans! There are traps already laid here!
czech_text: Pozor pod nohy, Sparťané! Jsou tu pasti!

english_text: Never again will your eagle rise, Germanicus!
Our allies are firing on us!
Our allies might be firing on us, but we must fight on!
czech_text: Spojenci po nás střílejí, ale bojujte dál!

english_text: Our foolish allies are standing in the way of our missile fire!
czech_text: Naši pošetilí spojenci nám stojí v palebné linii!

english_text: Our men are cowards! They're routing!
Our men are receiving fire from allied units!
Our men flee the field, broken!
czech_text: Naši muži se dali na útěk!

english_text: Our own allies are firing on us? I shall remember this!
czech_text: Spojenci po nás střílejí? To si zapamatuji!

english_text: Our unit has recovered! Back to the fray!
czech_text: Naši muži se vzchopili! Zpět do boje!

english_text: Remember this day! We are victorious!
czech_text: Pamatujte si tento den! Zvítězili jsme!

english_text: Return with these shields, or upon them!
Slowly! We don't want to be caught in our own traps!
czech_text: Pomalu! Ať nevkročíme do vlastních pastí!

english_text: Spartan strength prevails! Miltiades is dead!
czech_text: Sparťanská síla zvítězila! Miltiadés je mrtev!

english_text: Stand by my side and we will have victory!
czech_text: Bojujte po mém boku a zvítězíme!

english_text: The battle draws to a close!
The day is lost, but not the war!
czech_text: Dnešní bitva je ztracena, válka ještě ne!

english_text: The enemy base will soon be ours!
The enemy draws first blood! Fight!
The gods honor us with victory!
The Iceni queen is no more!
The Numidian king has been put to death!
Their impaled bodies will be our wall! Place stakes!
czech_text: Jejich těla na kůlech budou hradbou! Kůly na místa!

english_text: They might not be Spartans, but we should not kill our own allies!
czech_text: Nejsou to Sparťané, ale spojence zabíjet nesmíme!

english_text: This area has been fortified by our allies! Keep a mindful eye!
czech_text: Spojenci tu postavili obranu! Dávejte pozor!

english_text: This is not the end of Rome!
Throw down tar and get moving!
Tonight we bring hell to dine with us! Place tar!
czech_text: Dnes jim rozpoutáme peklo! Připravte dehet!

english_text: We are defeated! Our base is lost!
We are killing our allies! Stop!
We are Spartans! We will rise again!
We fire on allied units! Hold!
We have first blood! Press the advantage!
czech_text: První krev je naše! Využijte převahu!

english_text: We have slain the enemy commander!
We have their base and victory!
We have trained for this all our lives!
czech_text: Na tohle jsme cvičili celý život!

english_text: We will return to fight another day!
We're being damaged by friendly fire!
Will not be defeated! Fight on!
Your shields are heavy! Drop them!
Your shields will not be needed!
